name: Tivan Limited
summary: Tivan Limited and its subsidiaries explore, evaluate and develop mineral properties in Australia, covering critical minerals, fluorite, vanadium, titanium, silver, lead, copper, tungsten and lithium. It focuses on the wholly owned Speewah fluorite and vanadium projects in the Kimberley region of Western Australia, and develops and commercialises TIVAN+ processing technology for recovering vanadium.
